plan.scope: First native/MLX greedy-output screen only; no tensor-state, numerical, quality, API or performance qualification
plan.rule: Identical frozen English prompt token IDs and all 128 output IDs/length finishes in code/prose, two alternating fresh requests each. Helpers and lookup speculation disabled. Preserve every divergence; no speed percentages, default change, automatic retry or partial resume. Native F32 KV is for this screen, not the everyday F16 profile. Normal pressure, zero new swap and existing native admission/floor required.

patch.scope: Private combined engine over original m5-copy containing exactly P07 ordered ten-expert reduction, W02 exact helper top10 selector with original tie/exception/subnormal fallback, and P11 V1 compact expert/token tiles. Existing independent GGML_M5_LAB_REDUCE10, GGML_M5_LAB_TOP10 and GGML_M5_LAB_COMPACT_TILES flags allow individual and combined profiles. No V2 column-first grid, P10 route reuse, QSA, draft-cap, graph/math/cache/precision/default changes beyond the three inherited mechanisms. Original selector marker/status and compact marker/counter retained; stack-only reduce10 once marker and private encoding counter occur after dispatch. TOP_K and MM_ID retain separate allocator-accounted scratch; reduction consumes normal projection output with original fusion and overlap checks.
